headline: Keio Corp Investigates Potential Data Breach Affecting 11 Million Individuals
summary: Japanese railway operator Keio Corp reported that personal information belonging to up to 11 million customers and employees across its group companies may have been compromised in a cyber breach.
why: Keio Corp is a major private railway and conglomerate operator in the Greater Tokyo Area.

impacts.name: Keio Corporation
impacts.why: Keio Corp faces reputational damage after reporting a potential data leak affecting 11 million people.
